_comment: Representative seed of real NCCI edits. Production: replace via a CmsCsvNCCIRuleProvider ingesting the full quarterly CMS PTP/MUE files (see src/rcm/rules/ncci.py docstring).

ptp_edits.rationale: Glucose (82947) is a component of the Basic Metabolic Panel (80048); never separately payable.
BMP is a component of the Comprehensive Metabolic Panel.
Alkaline phosphatase is a component of the CMP.
Total cholesterol is a component of the lipid panel.
Triglycerides are a component of the lipid panel.
Manual therapy with therapeutic activities: payable only when performed in separate body regions/sessions (distinct-service modifier required).
Manual therapy with therapeutic exercise requires a distinct-service modifier.
Rhythm ECG is a component of the complete 12-lead ECG.
Chondroplasty in the same knee compartment is bundled into meniscectomy.
Sigmoidoscopy is bundled into colonoscopy with biopsy.
Debridement with simple repair payable only for a distinct site.

mue_limits.rationale: One BMP per date of service.
Manual therapy, 15-min units, max 4 per day.
Therapeutic activities, 15-min units, max 4 per day.
Chest X-ray 2 views, max 2 per day.
Botulinum toxin type A, units per day.
